//: CSS linting has two load-bearing contracts: feature colours come from the
design tokens, and the live weekly/shared UI only asks the font files for
weights they actually ship (400/500).
WHY THE COLOUR RULE EXISTS. tokens.css opens with 'Do not add colours
outside this file.' That rule was stated for a long time and enforced by
nothing — JS and TSX are linted with oxlint and --deny-warnings, while the
design-system and feature CSS had no equivalent guard. A raw hex added in a
feature module is invisible to review until somebody notices one theme is
wrong, and a literal cannot vary by theme.
WHY THE FONT-WEIGHT RULE EXISTS. The production UI loads Inter and Space
Grotesk at 400 and 500 only. Repeated UI reviews found 600/700 declarations
that browsers could only synthesize. The weekly product now expresses
hierarchy with the weights it owns plus size, spacing, contrast and
structure, so CSS lint protects that decision instead of relying on every
future author remembering it.
WHY stylelint-config-standard IS NOT EXTENDED. It brings roughly forty
stylistic rules that would fail across existing files on introduction, and
fixing them is a formatting change dressed up as a lint adoption. These
rules are deliberately narrow and each protects a product/design authority.
WHICH COLOUR PROPERTIES, AND WHY box-shadow IS ABSENT. '/color$/' covers
color, background-color, border-color, outline-color and the rest by
suffix; fill and stroke are the SVG equivalents. box-shadow is composite —
offsets, blur, spread, THEN a colour — so a whole-value strict-value check
cannot distinguish a tokenised shadow from a literal one without rejecting
correct declarations. That compromise is explicit rather than hidden.
WHY color-mix() IS IGNORED. Its arguments carry the colour, and current
uses pass design tokens. The rule compares whole values, so without the
exception it rejects the tokenised idiom the design system intentionally
uses.
WHY THE WEIGHT GUARD IS SCOPED. app/design-system plus Hub, leagues,
profile and season are the live shared weekly product finalised in the
current programme. Euro tournament UI, admin, reference prototypes and the
not-yet-wired onboarding journey have separate product/rollout authority and
must not be restyled merely to make this weekly guard pass.

scale-unlimited/declaration-strict-value.message: Use a design token — var(--…) — rather than a literal colour. Colours are defined in src/styles/tokens.css and nowhere else.

//overrides: tokens.css is where colour literals live, so the colour rule cannot apply
to it. fonts.css carries @font-face declarations. src/premium/** is a
reference-only parallel prototype application with its own provisional
brand, pinned as unreachable from production by its boundary test.
The font-weight guard is intentionally narrower than the colour guard. It
protects the live weekly/shared product without silently changing separate
Euro, admin, prototype or onboarding scopes.
